title: Add manual operator SSH recovery workflow

spec.problem: Recover operator SSH access through the existing production runner with a manually approved IPv4-scoped UFW rule.

acceptance.text: Only workflow_dispatch on refs/heads/main can run; production runner labels, oracle-production environment/concurrency, read-only contents and five-minute timeout match production.
operator_ip enters through OPERATOR_IP; Python explicitly validates IPv4 and is_global before quoted sudo -n ufw allow from that address to TCP port 22.
No account, SSH key, secret or other firewall changes; configuration and dry-run checks verify valid and invalid inputs without changing the real firewall.

spec.expected_behavior: Manual dispatch on main only uses the production runner, protected environment, and shared deployment concurrency; validates global IPv4 before one quoted sudo UFW allow command and status.
spec.rollback_plan: Remove this temporary workflow after recovery; the operator can separately remove its exact scoped UFW allow rule. This local task performs no remote firewall operation.

classification.rationale: Environment-only manual recovery workflow with no application behavior change or meaningful unit RED; config and mocked-UFW dry runs, full harness, and independent review replace unit RED. The harness does not allow a redundant config_only exception for non_behavioral changes.
